name: Sanmina Corporation
addedReason: up ~18.8% premarket after Q4 FY2026 beat and FY2027 guidance raise

growth.note: Full-year FY2026 revenue $14.53B vs prior year, driven largely by the ZT Systems acquisition; Q4 FY2026 revenue (~$3.86-3.9B) grew ~84% YoY on the same driver.

sharesOutstanding.note: Undated but consistent across multiple sources and arithmetically consistent with the $155/share, $8.3B market-cap readings.

cash.note: FY2026 (ended 2026-10-03) cash and cash equivalents; total available liquidity (incl. credit facilities) cited at $3.83B. Debt figure not found this session.

pe.note: Trailing computed from $155.43 close / $6.85 FY2026 GAAP diluted EPS. Using non-GAAP FY2026 EPS ($13.28) instead gives 11.71 — both bases are legitimate reads and not reconciled to a single 'trailing P/E' here. Forward is $155.43 / $16.50 (midpoint of FY2027 non-GAAP EPS guidance $15.50-$17.50) — a company-guidance-based estimate, not a consensus analyst figure.

nextEarnings.note: Not found. Sanmina's fiscal Q1 ends late December; last year's fiscal Q1 2026 call was Jan 26, 2026, so fiscal Q1 2027 would likely fall late Jan 2027 — inference only, not a confirmed date.

catalysts.headline: Sanmina reported Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended 2026-10-03) revenue of $3.86B with a 6.0% GAAP operating margin; FY2026 full-year revenue grew 79% and non-GAAP operating profit rose 130%. Issued FY2027 outlook implying ~27% revenue growth and ~24% non-GAAP diluted EPS growth at the midpoint, citing AI/data-center demand.

Sanmina reports Q4 and full-year FY2026 results: Q4 revenue ~$3.86-3.9B (+84% YoY) on the ZT Systems acquisition, non-GAAP diluted EPS $4.43, GAAP diluted EPS $2.14; FY2026 revenue a record $14.53B (+79% YoY), GAAP diluted EPS $6.85, non-GAAP EPS $13.28, full-year GAAP operating margin 4.7%; issues FY2027 guidance of $17.5-19.5B revenue and $15.50-17.50 non-GAAP EPS, with Q1 FY2027 revenue guided to $3.8-4.1B
catalysts.impact: Stock reported +18.8% per file for 2026-11-10; this session could not independently reconfirm the exact percentage (SEC EDGAR and most stock-data sites were unreachable via WebFetch), but secondary coverage (Webull, rallies.ai) independently describes a sharp rally tied to the Q4 beat and confident FY2027 AI/cloud-infrastructure guidance, consistent in direction.

conflicts: Market cap readings disagree by source/date: $8.33B at $155.43 (Nov 11, stockevents.app) vs. $8.87B at $165.57 (debelegger.nl, dated late Oct, now stale) vs. $8.35B (fool.com, undated). The Nov 11 reading is used as the most recent.
notes: No new catalyst found this session beyond the Q4 FY2026 earnings beat already on file; this pass fills in previously-missing market cap, shares outstanding, cash, and a derived P/E. Debt and short interest remain unestablished.
